choppiness_filter.computation: abs(close[i] - close[i-lookback+1]) / sum(high[j] - low[j] for j in [i-lookback+1..i])

dr2.computation: r2[i] - r2[i-1] where r2 = linear regression R-squared on close over lookback bars
dr2.interpretation: negative = R2 falling = trend dissolving = favorable for rotation entry

dslope.computation: abs(slope[i]) - abs(slope[i-1]) where slope = linear regression slope on close
dslope.interpretation: negative = abs_slope falling = trend weakening = favorable for rotation entry

entry_signal_filter.gate_behavior: skip entry when dr2 > -0.40 OR dslope > -2.0 (applied after chop filter)

fade_confirm_filter.prev_bar: last completed 250-tick aggregated bar before the entry bar
fade_confirm_filter.guard: if prev_bar range == 0, set fade_confirm = 0.5 (neutral, passes filter)
fade_confirm_filter.guard_nan: if prev_bar data unavailable (warmup), allow entry
fade_confirm_filter.interpretation: low fade_confirm = entry price near support/resistance side of previous bar = pullback has displaced forcefully = favorable for mean reversion
fade_confirm_filter.gate_behavior: skip entry when fade_confirm >= 0.40 (applied after entry signal filter)

validation.sanity_check: PASS - fade_confirm E[R]=$78.16 beats all 10 random seeds (max random=$5.56, margin=$72.60)

killed_at_step3_redundancy: direction_bars (rho=0.67 with fade_speed, weakest in cluster)
avg_range_decay (5.1pt SR spread, moderate but non-monotonic)
survivors_step3: fade_confirm (23.4pt SR spread, rho=0.20 with fade_speed)
feature_selection.final_winner: fade_confirm alone (12/12 weeks improved vs 11/12 for combined; 98% vs 82% retention)
feature_selection.dropped_at_step6: fade_speed (combined filter hurts W48, lower retention, more complex for marginal total PnL gain)

key_finding: All hypotheses were inverted: fades work best when the pullback is at maximum momentum (low fade_confirm = entry near support), NOT when exhausting. Volume (flow_confirm) showed signal for the first time but was redundant with fade_speed.
